en: A sepia-toned photographic postcard showing a young woman in historical or peasant-style dress standing by a window, leaning forward and looking outside. She wears a cap and long dress, and there is a spinning wheel in the foreground. The setting appears to be an interior room with carved wooden furniture. Text at the top left reads "HELENA FORTI. 'Stella maris.'" At the bottom left is the photographer or publisher credit "HAHN NACHF. DRESDEN." and at the bottom right are small numbers and initials.
